instruction: Choose a skeleton that fits the section, then BUILD to it: place the real elements in its slots, honour its type scale / spacing / balance, and skin it with the committed Style. Combine skeletons across a page for rhythm (see each one's pairsWith). These are references, not rigid templates — adapt, but do not fall back to a generic stack.

compositions.summary: A single centred stack of equal cards rotates in 3D perspective (depth-sorted so one face reads front while the others fall back), a giant running marquee shows through the gaps behind it, and a lone pill CTA is pinned centre-bottom.

slots.at: full-width band across the vertical centre, behind the cards
slots.note: blurred, seen through the carousel gaps

slots.at: dead-centre, four equal cards rotating on a shared axis, one front-facing
slots.note: depth-sorted: front card sharp, side/back cards recede

slots.at: bottom-centre, single pill button

type.notes: The only large type is the backdrop marquee; the cards carry their own internal type.

space.whitespace: The single card stack floats in the centre with wide empty margins on every side; the marquee fills the void behind rather than around it.

balance.focal: the front-facing carousel card at dead centre
balance.weight: even, radial around the centre with a bottom-anchored CTA
balance.notes: Perfect central symmetry; depth (z-order), not position, creates the hierarchy among the cards.

compositions.summary: A left-aligned, vertically-centred stack — oversized two-line heading (second line dimmed), a short sub line, and a pill button — sits against generous empty space to its right where a focal chrome object lives.

slots.at: right side of the frame, focal chrome object the copy is placed beside
left, vertically centred, two lines (second dimmed)
left, under headline, narrow measure
left, below sub, pill button

type.notes: The heading dominates; a dimmed second line adds a soft second beat before the small sub and button.

space.whitespace: The right half is left almost entirely open for the focal object; copy is packed into the left third and vertically centred.

balance.focal: the oversized left heading, balanced by the focal object on the right
balance.notes: A classic left-copy / right-object split; the empty right side gives the closing statement room to land.

compositions.summary: A full-bleed shader card frames an oversized top-left headline and a floating, cursor-tilted image card centred over it; the bottom edge carries a supporting paragraph with a button pair, a divider, and a social-proof pill balanced against a right-aligned line.

slots.at: entire frame, behind everything (animated shader gradient)
top-left, two lines (second line dimmed)
centre, floating card with 3D perspective tilt, overlapping the headline
slots.note: grows to cover the frame as it flips into the carousel

slots.at: dead-centre, rotated label over the card
bottom-left, narrow measure above the buttons
bottom-left row, two buttons (ghost + solid)
bottom-left, social-proof pill with avatar stack (below a full-width divider)
bottom-right, right-aligned single line

type.notes: Huge low-contrast-weight display headline over a bright shader; body copy is small and calm.

space.whitespace: Big empty mid-field so the floating card reads; content compressed to the top-left corner and the bottom band, the centre reserved for the focal tile.

balance.focal: the floating centre card, then the oversized top-left headline
balance.weight: top-left and bottom-heavy, framing a central focal object
balance.notes: Corner-loaded copy leaves the middle open for the tilting card that becomes the carousel's first face.

compositions.summary: A row of wide, full-height media cards runs off the right edge and pans horizontally as one track; each card carries a small meta tag-row at the top and an oversized case title anchored at the bottom.

slots.at: each card, full-bleed video behind the text
top of each card, inline meta row (client · year · discipline)
bottom of each card, case title

type.notes: Each card repeats the same top-meta / bottom-title contrast; the big title carries it.

space.whitespace: Even gaps between cards; each card is internally split top-vs-bottom with the video filling the middle. The track overflows the right edge to signal more.

balance.focal: the leading card's bottom title, then the horizontal run of cards
balance.weight: left-anchored track bleeding right, bottom-weighted within each card
balance.notes: Repetition and equal card widths make the horizontal pan read as a continuous filmstrip.

compositions.summary: A single rounded card sits on a full-bleed image; a thin header row (brand mark left, url right) tops it, a glass pill or search bar floats in the upper-middle, and a lead headline anchors the bottom edge.

slots.at: entire card, behind the chrome (full-bleed image)
top row, brand mark left and url right
upper-middle, floating glass pill / search bar with leading + trailing chips
slots.note: product-UI mock element

slots.at: bottom, lead line with an emphasised tail word

type.notes: One lead sentence with a bolded tail carries the card; header/pill text is fine print.

space.whitespace: Uniform padding inside the rounded card; header pinned top, lead pinned bottom, the middle left open for the image and floating pill.

balance.focal: the bottom lead headline, then the floating pill
balance.notes: Header and lead frame the image top and bottom; the pill breaks the vertical run to signal it is live product UI.

compositions.summary: A full-screen dark panel holds a particle sphere and a small mark at dead centre; a headline splits across opposite corners (top-left and bottom-right) and a supporting paragraph rises in from the bottom-left, orbiting the focal object diagonally.

slots.at: entire frame, dark panel backdrop
dead-centre, particle sphere with a small mark at its core
top-left corner, first part of a split heading
bottom-right corner, remaining lines, right-aligned
bottom-left, short stacked paragraphs, narrow measure

type.notes: A single statement is torn across two opposite corners so the eye sweeps diagonally through the focal object.

space.whitespace: Vast dark negative space; content lives only in the corners so the sphere owns the centre and reads as suspended in void.

balance.focal: the central particle sphere
balance.weight: diagonal, top-left to bottom-right, pivoting on the centre
balance.notes: Opposite-corner headings create a diagonal tension line that passes straight through the focal object.

compositions.summary: One rounded translucent capsule holds the whole enquiry: two unlabelled fields sitting side by side on the left, and a filled action pill inset flush against the capsule's own right edge. Below the small breakpoint the capsule opens into a stacked card with a full-width action.

slots.at: inside the capsule, first of two inline fields, left of centre
slots.note: placeholder-only; the label is present for assistive tech but not drawn

slots.at: inside the capsule, immediately right of the first, same width
flush to the capsule's inner right edge, a filled pill inset by the capsule's own padding
slots.note: a pill inside a pill — the inset is what makes the whole thing read as one object rather than a form plus a button

slots.at: the capsule's own hairline border, plus a light catch along its inner bottom edge

type.displaySize: moderate — the action label one small step above the field text
type.notes: No headings, no helper text, no field labels. The entire block is one line of type plus a button label, which is why it can sit under a display heading without competing with it.

space.whitespace: All the air is outside the capsule, not inside it: a wide gap between the two fields and a generous left inset are the only internal breathing room, so the object stays compact against a large empty field.

balance.focal: the filled action pill
balance.notes: A single filled shape at one end of a long translucent bar. The asymmetry is safe because the capsule itself is centred — the block reads as balanced on the page while the eye still lands on the action.

compositions.summary: One full-bleed media frame is the whole page: a hairline masthead caps the top, a translucent stat bar closes the base, two full-height hairline rules divide the field into thirds, and a two-line display heading over a single inline enquiry capsule floats centred in the band between the bars.

slots.at: entire frame, behind everything
slots.note: the only image in the composition; it carries the whole background and responds to the pointer

slots.at: over the media, edge to edge
slots.note: a light wash so the centred copy holds contrast without darkening the picture into a flat plate

slots.at: top edge, one short row closed by a hairline; mark centred between two link groups
two full-height hairlines, equally inset from each side, running from under the masthead to the base
slots.note: they rule the frame into thirds and carry on across the glass bar rather than stopping at it; the inset is symmetric so they never drift on wide viewports

slots.at: centred in the band between the two bars, two deliberate lines
centred directly under the headline, one inline capsule on a short measure
bottom edge, translucent bar spanning the full width
slots.note: delegated to a stat-band skeleton; from the hero's point of view it is a base rail

type.displaySize: large display (to ~4.5vw), dropping to ~2x body on narrow viewports
type.notes: One display face carries the heading, the mark and the figures; everything else sits at a single body size. The restraint is the point — the contrast comes from the empty field, not from a size jump.

space.whitespace: The middle two-thirds hold only two short centred objects; every other element is pushed hard to the top or bottom edge, so the media reads through the middle of the screen uninterrupted.

balance.focal: the centred display line, then the capsule beneath it
balance.weight: even, centred between two pinned rails
balance.notes: Symmetry without stiffness: the vertical rules and the two bars build a strict frame, and the only things inside it are two short centred elements. The composition survives any viewport because nothing is pinned to an absolute x — the rules are inset from both edges and the centre column is measured, not positioned.

compositions.summary: A single short row across the top edge, closed by a hairline: two small link groups pushed to the outer margins with the mark absolutely centred between them, so the mark sits on the page's centre line whatever the groups measure. Stacks to mark-over-groups when the row runs out of room.

layout.split: outer groups | centred mark (out of flow)

slots.at: top-left, horizontal link group flush to the left margin
absolutely centred in the bar, out of the flow
slots.note: centred against the page, not against the two groups — the one detail that stops it reading as a generic split bar

slots.at: top-right, horizontal link group flush to the right margin
hairline closing the base of the bar, full width

type.displaySize: moderate — the mark sits one small step above the links
type.notes: The mark is set in the display face and uppercased; every link is one body size. The hierarchy is positional, not typographic.

space.whitespace: A shallow band hugging the top edge, with wide gaps inside each link group so the row reads as three light clusters rather than a dense menu.

balance.focal: the centred mark
balance.notes: Taking the mark out of the flow rather than making it a third flex child is what holds the symmetry — unequal link groups no longer push it off axis. The hairline underneath turns three floating clusters into one bar.

compositions.summary: A shallow translucent rail pinned to the base of the frame and opened by a hairline: a figure-over-label pair on each flank, and a centred column between them holding a short title, a dot, and a two-line pitch. The flanks are content-sized and the centre is measured, so the pitch stays on the page's axis whatever the figures read.

slots.at: hairline across the top edge of the rail, full width
left flank, figure above its label, left-aligned to the outer margin
slots.note: the label sits under the figure visually but stays after it in reading order

slots.at: centre column, one short title line
centre column, a single dot between the title and the pitch
slots.note: a dot rather than a rule — it separates without drawing a second horizontal line into a band that already has one

slots.at: centre column, short pitch on a narrow measure, centred under the dot
right flank, figure above its label, right-aligned to the outer margin

type.displaySize: large (the figures and the centre title share one step)
type.notes: Figures and title sit at exactly the same size, so the rail reads as one sentence across the base rather than as two stat callouts with copy wedged between them.

space.whitespace: A shallow band — the flanks shrink to their content so the centre column keeps most of the width, and the pitch is held to a narrow measure rather than filling it.

balance.focal: the centred title, then the two figures read as a pair
balance.notes: Equal fractional flanks around an auto centre is what keeps the symmetry honest: a longer figure on one side steals from its own flank, never from the centre. On narrow viewports the centre column takes a full row of its own and the two figures pair up beneath it, which preserves the reading order instead of squeezing three cells into one line.

compositions.summary: Three stacked registers: a 7|5 top row where a display heading faces a stack of three short paragraphs, then an equal three-up image triptych, then a four-cell label/value ledger under a hairline — each register wider and quieter than the one above.

layout.split: 12-col: 7 | 5 top row, then equal-3, then equal-4

slots.at: above the heading, small caps with a lead rule
top-left, spanning 7 columns, held to a ~20ch measure so it breaks into three lines
top-right, spanning 5 columns — three short paragraphs stacked, each ~52ch
slots.note: runs alongside the heading rather than under it, so the two read as a spread

slots.at: middle register, an equal three-up row of landscape plates
slots.note: each plate scales inside a fixed frame on hover

slots.at: bottom register, four equal label/value cells under a full-width hairline
slots.size: extra-small caps labels over body values

type.notes: Only one display element; the three registers descend in type size (display → body → small caps) which is what makes the stack read as settling rather than repeating.

space.whitespace: Register gaps grow as you descend (5rem to the triptych, 4rem to the ledger) and the top row's 7|5 split leaves the heading's short measure open to its right.

balance.focal: the heading, then the middle plate of the triptych
balance.notes: An asymmetric 7|5 top row resolves into an equal three-up and then an equal four-up — the section literally settles into symmetry as it descends, which is why the ledger reads as a full stop.

compositions.summary: A head row that hangs a display heading and a lead paragraph from a shared bottom edge, then a two-up grid of plates each closed by a hairline-topped caption row with a three-line description at the left and the price pushed hard right, and a single centred button underneath.

layout.split: head row: heading | lead, bottom-aligned; body: equal-2

slots.at: above the heading in the head row, small caps with a lead rule
head row left, ~18ch measure
head row right, ~42ch, aligned to the heading's bottom edge rather than its top
slots.note: the bottom alignment is the move — the paragraph hangs off the heading's baseline, not beside its cap line

slots.at: each card, a plate whose aspect ratio varies per item
slots.note: lifts and scales slightly on hover; the whole card is one link

slots.at: under each plate, a hairline-topped row
slots.note: title / medium / edition stacked at the left in descending size and ink; price set in the display face and pushed hard right, top-aligned with the title

slots.at: centred beneath the grid — the only centred element in the section

type.notes: Each caption is a four-step ladder — title, medium, edition in caps, price in the display face — so a card carries four type registers in a 5rem-tall block.

space.whitespace: Row gap is markedly larger than column gap (3.5rem vs 2.5rem) so the pairs read as rows of two rather than two long columns.

balance.focal: the head row's heading, then the first plate
balance.notes: The one asymmetry is the baseline-hung head row; everything below it is an even two-up, and the centred closing button seals the symmetry.

compositions.summary: A full-viewport tonal inversion: the ground flips to the dark surface and a narrow copy column (eyebrow, heading, body, one button) sits vertically centred against a portrait plate five columns wide on the right, with a wide empty column between them.

layout.split: 12-col: 6 | 5 (right column starts at 8 — one column left empty between)

slots.at: top of the copy column, small caps with a lead rule
copy column, one or two lines only
copy column, a single short paragraph held to ~34rem
copy column base, a single solid button in the inverted ground colour
slots.note: trailing arrow slides on hover

slots.at: right, a portrait plate narrower than the copy column and vertically centred

type.notes: Smaller display size than the hero on purpose — this band interrupts, it does not restart. Body copy is muted against the inverted ground; the button is the only full-contrast element.

space.whitespace: Full viewport height for four elements. The copy column is capped well below its six columns and the media starts at column 8, so a whole empty column separates them.

balance.focal: the tonal flip itself, then the heading
balance.notes: The section earns its height by being the only inverted band in a long light page — the arrest comes from the ground change, not from the layout, so the layout stays deliberately plain.

compositions.summary: A tonal band where a heading sits over a three-column list with no column gap — every cell opens with its own hairline and carries a two-digit index beside a display-face name, so the cells knit into a continuous ruled lattice rather than three separate lists.

slots.at: above the heading, small caps with a lead rule
top-left, ~18ch measure, separated from the lattice by a deep gap
each cell's left, a zero-padded two-digit numeral in the display face at a muted ink value
slots.note: numbering runs across the rows, not down the columns — it re-reads the grid as one sequence

slots.at: each cell, a name set in the display face on the numeral's baseline

type.notes: Entries and their indices share the display face at different sizes and ink values — the section is typographic all the way down, with no body-face copy at all.

space.whitespace: No column gutter and only 1.5rem of row padding, so the lattice is the densest thing on the page — the section's air is all in the deep gap between the heading and the first rule.

balance.focal: the heading, then the top-left cell; the eye then reads across the rules
balance.notes: Dropping the column gutter is what makes it work — each row's three hairlines join into one unbroken rule across the page, so the grid reads as a ledger, and a tonal ground shift separates it from the light bands around it.

compositions.summary: A 4|8 split: a short heading column on the left leaves the accordion two thirds of the grid, where each row is a hairline-topped full-width button with the question in the display face at the left and a plus glyph pushed hard right that rotates as the answer opens.

slots.at: top of the narrow column, small caps with a lead rule
narrow left column, ~18ch measure — wraps to three or four short lines because the column is only a third of the grid
right column, stacked rows each opened by a hairline that spans the full eight columns
each row, the question in the display face at the left of a full-width toggle
each row's far right, a plus glyph that rotates a quarter turn into a cross when open
each open row, in the panel beneath the question, ~60ch measure
slots.note: the panel's height is measured, not guessed, so it animates from zero to its natural height

type.displaySize: heading 4.5rem in a third-width column; questions 1.5rem
type.notes: Questions are set in the display face at body-adjacent size, so the accordion reads as a run of small headings rather than as UI.

space.whitespace: Every row pads 2rem above and below its own text, so a closed accordion is already a tall, airy column; the narrow heading column leaves its right half empty as the section's breathing room.

balance.focal: the heading, then the first rule
balance.notes: Squeezing the heading into four columns forces it to wrap into a tall block, which is what visually balances eight columns of rules — a wider heading column would have left the accordion looking like an afterthought.

compositions.summary: An inverted footer in three registers: a 5|2|2|3 column row where a brand block with an italic tagline faces three small-caps link columns, then a viewport-wide wordmark set at extreme size in a near-transparent ink, then a hairline-topped bar splitting copyright left from legal links right.

slots.at: top of the brand column, a small lockup — rotated-square glyph plus lowercase mark
under the lockup, a one-line tagline in italic display face, held to ~28ch
brand column base, a contact address as a small-caps text link
three link columns to the right, each a small-caps column title over a stacked link list
slots.size: extra-small caps titles over body links

slots.at: below the columns, a single word set edge-to-edge at viewport scale in the near-transparent ink
slots.note: decorative and clipped by the section — it is a texture, not a heading; hidden from assistive tech

slots.at: bottom bar under a hairline, copyright left and legal links right on one baseline

type.notes: The biggest type on the entire page sits in the footer at almost no contrast — scale carries it, ink does not. Tracking is tight on the bleed wordmark and wide on every small-caps label. The tagline is the only italic here besides the accent word.

space.whitespace: A deep 6rem gap opens before the bleed wordmark so it reads as a separate register, and the wordmark's own tight leading (~0.8) keeps it a band rather than a line.

balance.focal: the bleed wordmark, despite being the faintest thing in the section
balance.notes: The column row is top-loaded and small; all the visual mass sits below it in a single ghosted word. It works because the wordmark is a texture — legible enough to name the site, quiet enough not to be a call to action.

compositions.summary: A viewport-tall 12-column split: a left copy column runs eyebrow → display headline → lead → paired buttons → a three-cell fact ledger under a hairline, while a tall portrait plate fills the right half and the two are vertically centred against each other.

slots.at: top of the left column, small caps preceded by a short lead rule
left column, held to a ~14-character measure so it breaks into three short lines
slots.note: one word set in an italic accent face against the rest

slots.at: left column under the headline, ~46ch measure
left column, inline pair — one solid, one hairline-outlined
slots.note: each carries a trailing arrow that slides on hover

slots.at: bottom of the left column, three equal cells under a full-width hairline
slots.size: extra-small caps labels over small values
slots.note: a fact ledger, not numbers — label/value pairs

slots.at: right half, a single tall portrait plate, taller than wide
below the copy column on narrow viewports only — a scroll cue beside a short rule

type.notes: A regular-weight serif display against a small sans lead; the caps-and-tracking of the eyebrow, buttons and ledger form one quiet register beneath it.

space.whitespace: Deep top padding clears the fixed bar; the copy column stacks with growing gaps (2rem → 2.5rem → 3rem) so the eye decelerates down it.

balance.focal: the headline, then the portrait
balance.notes: The left column carries five stacked elements against the right's one; the portrait's height is what balances that count, and the shared vertical centring locks them together.

compositions.summary: A fixed hairline-free bar in three columns: a two-line positioning statement at the left, the wordmark dead-centre, and a small-caps link row plus a two-rule menu toggle pushed right — inverted against whatever scrolls beneath it.

slots.at: left column, two stacked lines — a sentence-case lead over a small-caps sub
centre column, optically centred on the viewport not the content
slots.note: a tiny rotated-square glyph sits to its left as a fixed lockup

slots.at: right column, inline small-caps link row
slots.note: each link carries a dot marker that only appears on hover

slots.at: far right, label beside a two-bar rule stack
slots.note: opens a full-screen overlay menu

type.notes: Everything is small; the only hierarchy is caps-and-tracking versus sentence case. The wordmark is the one display-face element.

space.whitespace: The bar owns only its own band — no ground, no rule, no shadow; the page reads straight through it.

balance.focal: the centred wordmark
balance.notes: Two equal outer columns of small type hold an auto-width centre steady, so the mark stays on the viewport centreline no matter how long the flanking text runs.

compositions.summary: A 5|7 split where the heading block pins in place while the right column scrolls a ruled list past it — each row a hairline-topped band with an oversized faint index numeral at the left and a title-plus-paragraph hung to its right.

slots.at: top of the sticky column, small caps with a lead rule
sticky left column, held to a ~18ch measure; stays fixed while the list scrolls
each row's left, an oversized numeral in the display face at the faintest ink value
slots.size: oversized (6rem, larger than the row's heading)
slots.note: big but faint — it structures the row without competing with the title

slots.at: each row, title hung to the right of the numeral and dropped slightly below its cap line
each row, under its title, ~48ch measure
right column — the rows themselves, each opened by a hairline that spans the column

type.notes: The largest type in the section is the faintest — the index numerals outsize the heading but sit at the lowest ink value, so scale and contrast pull in opposite directions.

space.whitespace: Each row runs 3rem of padding above and below its hairline, and the numeral/title gap is a full 3rem — the rows breathe like catalogue entries, not list items.

balance.focal: the pinned heading, then each numeral as it arrives
balance.weight: right-weighted in motion, left-anchored at rest
balance.notes: Pinning the smaller column is the whole trick: the heading becomes a fixed caption for a moving list, so the section reads as one idea with four instances rather than five separate blocks.

compositions.summary: One held-back band: a small-caps eyebrow, then a single passage set at display size in the display face across a wide measure, closed by a short italic signature — the whole section is three left-aligned things and a great deal of air.

slots.at: top-left, small caps preceded by a short lead rule
below, a single paragraph promoted to display size across the full measure
slots.note: body copy doing a headline's job — the section has no heading at all

slots.at: bottom-left, an em-dashed initials signature in italic

type.notes: The only typographic move is scale: a paragraph in the display face at heading size. Loose leading (~1.25) keeps a long passage readable at that size.

space.whitespace: A narrower measure than every neighbouring section, so the band visibly indents from the page's full width; 3rem gaps above and below the passage isolate it.

balance.focal: the passage — there is nothing else to look at
balance.notes: A deliberate pause between two busy sections. It works because the measure narrows and nothing competes: no image, no rule, no button.

compositions.summary: A heading block sits above a 12-column field where each work occupies seven columns and alternates side — odd items start at column 1, even items start at column 6 and are pushed down a further section-height — so the plates interleave down the page instead of forming rows.

layout.split: 12-col: each item spans 7, starting alternately at 1 and 6

slots.at: above the heading, small caps with a lead rule
top-left, held to a ~18ch measure
slots.note: one word set in an italic accent face

slots.at: each item's plate, spanning 7 of 12 and alternating left/right start
slots.note: aspect ratios vary per item (landscape and portrait mixed) so the interleave never falls into a rhythm

slots.at: under each plate, a hairline-topped baseline row
slots.note: title over medium on the left, year pushed hard right on the same baseline

type.notes: The section heading is the only large type; every caption is body-size, with the year in the display face so it reads as a mark rather than a label.

space.whitespace: The alternating five-column shortfall becomes the section's whitespace — each plate leaves a tall empty gutter opposite it, and the even items' extra top offset stops the two edges ever aligning.

balance.focal: the first plate, then the eye zig-zags down the offsets
balance.notes: Overlap is what makes it: seven-of-twelve twice means the two columns share column 6-7, so consecutive plates almost touch and the page reads as one descending stagger rather than a two-up grid.

compositions.summary: A rounded panel that overlaps the section above it, split into a narrow intro column — small square tile, three-line heading, short body — and a row of equal portrait cards whose bottoms align except for the middle one, which is lifted clear of the baseline.

slots.at: left column top, small square tile
slots.note: scales up into place as the column enters

slots.at: left column, three clipped lines under the tile
left column base, deliberately narrow measure
right column, row of three equal portrait cards (3:4), bottoms aligned
